contexts.text: The rational things (of the celestial man) are compared to a forest of cedars and similar trees, such as existed on Lebanon.
The forest of the south () = those who are in the light of truths, and extinguish it; thus those who are of such a character within the Church.
When the Angels are discoursing about the things of intelligence and wisdom, and about perceptions and Knowledges... it falls into representations of... paradises, vineyards, forests, etc.

To spend the night in the forest () = to be desolated as to good; for Arabia = those who are in celestial things, that is, who are in the goods of faith; to spend the night in the forest there = to be no longer in goods, whence comes desolation. ( = to be vastated as to truth. AC 3268:7.)
The boar in the wood () = falsity.
(Spirits who) dwell in dark forests. Described. SE 1782.
They who attribute all things to their Own prudence, are like those who wander in dark forests, and do not know the way out... SE 4393.
To hew wood () = to place merit in works; but to hew wood in a forest = to discuss these and the like things, and also to bring them into debate; for a forest = what is religious.

To cut down wood in the forest () = to act from a false religion, and to destroy such things as are of the Church; for the Church is called a forest, a garden, and a paradise; a forest from knowledge, a garden from intelligence, and a paradise from wisdom. For trees = the perceptions of good and truth; and also the Knowledges of them. And as a forest = the Church as to knowledge, thus as to external things, it also = what is religious.

The Church as to knowledge, or as to external things, is signified by a forest, in... Then shall all the trees of the forest sing (); and in... We found Him in the fields of the wood ()... In , his forest = the Church as to the Knowledges of truth; and Carmel = the Church as to the Knowledges of good.
Wood out of the field () = the interior goods of the Church; and wood out of the forests = the exterior goods. AC 9228:2.
Wood from the forests = the scientifics of good and truth.
In the fields of the wood = in the natural or literal sense of the Word. AE 684:27. AE 700:9.
The fields of the wood = the goods of the Church with the Gentiles.
A forest = what is scientific regnant; but a garden = truth regnant.
Forests (seen in the First Earth).
Men who... come into the other life, and who bring with them truths of faith in the natural memory only... appear to themselves to wander among broken pieces of rock, and in forests.
(In the Second Earth) there are forests full of fruit trees...
Each species of tree = a species of perception and of Knowledge. Hence it is that paradises and gardens = heavenly intelligence and wisdom; and forests, the knowledge of the natural man.
(In the Hells) there are dark forests, in which infernal Spirits wander about like wild beasts. HH 587:end. SE 4854. SE 4897.
By a garden, a grove, and a forest, are meant wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge.
The forests which he strips bare () = the scientifics and cognitions which the Word opens to them.
The Word is like a garden... The man who is in truths, not from doctrine, but from the mere sense of the letter, is at the circumference, and sees nothing but forest trees.
In some places in Hell there are forests of trees which bear evil fruits, in correspondence with the concupiscences and the derivative thoughts of those who are there.
(Three forests through which Swedenborg passed on his way to visit those who had lived respectively in the Golden Age, in the Iron Age, and in the Age which succeeded. Described.) CL 78:2. CL 79:2.
[151a] 3. In forests there have been found men like beasts...
(Relation concerning satyrs seen in a forest.)

The next day... the forest (of the satyrs) had disappeared, and in its place there was a sandy plain, with a lake in the middle containing some red serpents. But some weeks after... I saw on its right side some fallow land...
(In that Earth whole forests are formed into palaces by training the trees.) Described.
While they live in the forests, but little life is allowed them.
In forests a man wanders; an animal never. Explained.
On the common people... such as live in forests...
(The Quaker Spirits, when under the influence of their holy spirit) seem to themselves and to others to be wandering in dense forests, like wild swine... LJPost 59.
The antediluvians... suppose themselves to dwell in forests.
On the right side (of the Heavens) there appeared a dense and dark forest, concerning which it was said that those are sent thither who are in falsities...
(Spirits who were wandering in forests.)

When any truth was mentioned, such persons at once descend into terms... This was represented as a dark forest, into which they cast themselves... Whereas such a forest is removed from those who are in simple good, and they are in an open plain...
A forest () = natural truth; and the trees therein = the Knowledges of truth. AE 326:11.
The forests in which they shall sleep () = the falsities thence derived which will not infest them.
A forest () = the sensuous man who is in mere fallacies and the derivative falsities.
A forest = what is merely natural.
By a forest () is meant the external or natural man as to all things which belong to him; and by every tree is meant what is a matter of knowledge therein.
By the forest of the south () is meant falsity within the Church, consequently those who are in falsities therein... Falsity from evil is signified by the forest.
A forest = what is natural; here (), what is natural separated from what is spiritual.
The forest of the south = the Church which is able to be in the light of truth from the Word, but now, which, being destitute of spiritual light, is in mere Knowledges.

Gardens or paradises, specifically. = the intelligence and wisdom appertaining to the men of the Church; and forests, or groves, = the intelligence of the natural man, which, regarded in itself, is knowledge, and is of service to the intelligence of the spiritual man.
The wild beast of the forest () = the affection of scientifics.
Beautiful with branch and with shady forest () = intelligence through rational truths by means of scientifics.

The nations which are outside the Church are signified by the wild beast in the forest (). The wild beast = the natural and sensuous man; and the forest, his knowledge and derivative obscure intelligence.

To sleep in the forests = that they will be safe from the infestation of these (cupidities and concupiscences), although in and among them. The desert and the forest are where such things and such Spirits are. AE 701:18.
The forest of his fruitful field () = scientific.
Are called paradises in the spiritual man, groves in the natural man, and shady forests in the sensuous man.

That from this he possesses the knowledge of the Knowledges of good and truth, is signified by the fruitful field shall be counted for a forest (). A forest is predicated of the natural man, as a garden is of the spiritual man; and therefore by a forest is signified knowledge, and by a garden intelligence. AE 1145:7.
